$Comment: Rage ultimate (2026-10-21: keep the base ultimate as it is, fixed; the rage one follows you). Exact copy of AT_Ice_King_Frost_Ultimate (same charge, same 7 Stab hit boxes of 0.37 s, same hit roots Root_AT_Ice_King_Frost_Ultimate_Tick/_Final, same animations), only the aim effect differs: AT_Ice_King_Beam_Focus_Rage instead of AT_Ice_King_Beam_Focus, so the beam sweeps after the player. If the base ultimate changes, copy it again and put the _Rage effect back. Base snapshot: backups/ice-king-ultimate-base-2026-10-21. 2026-10-21 (playtest: much longer range, so he can hit me from the sky or across the field): each Stab box reaches 60 blocks (EndDistance, was 24). The box sweeps from 0 to 60 blocks within each 0.37 s tick (StabSelector), and still needs line of sight. 2026-10-21 (playtest: it aimed at my feet): starts with AT_Ice_King_Beam_Charge on himself for the 1.8 s charge + re-aim, so his head aims at the target's eyes (Template_AT_Ice_King, HeadMotion Watch) and the beam locks onto the body. 2026-10-21 (playtest: the ultimate freezes everything, allies too, without hurting them): every Stab box hits PLAYERS with the damaging root (HitEntityRules, Player matcher) and everything else (his Gunters and snowmen, other mobs) with Root_AT_Ice_King_Frost_Ultimate_Freeze_Only: frozen, no damage. 2026-10-21 (playtest: hurt every creature but ice creatures, and freeze them all, only with the ultimate): non-players now get Root_AT_Ice_King_Frost_Ultimate_Mob_Tick/_Final (AT_Ice_King_Freeze_Ultimate, which ignores Immunity_Freeze, + the ice damage, which the king's ice creatures resist with AT_Ice_King_Ice_Body). The freeze-only root is gone. 2026-10-21 (playtest: the base ultimate in phase 1, the rage one in phase 4): used by the flying enraged phase on its own timer (Component_AT_Ice_King_Air_Enraged_Combat), so it has no MovementEffects (a movement lock on a flier is untested); AT_Ice_King_Beam_Focus_Rage (speed x0.2) already slows his flight and turning while it fires, and the component's casting rule turns his body to his aim. Phase 1 keeps the base ultimate. 2026-10-21 (playtest: light the ground under the beam): before each hit box a light carrier projectile (Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Beam_Light, invisible, light radius 6, no damage) flies down the beam, so the ground along it stays lit while it fires. 2026-10-21 (playtest: the light went on far past the end of the beam): each light projectile despawns after 0.95 s (ProjectileInteraction Lifetime); at its ~60 blocks/s that is about the beam's 60 blocks. Lower it if the light still overshoots the tip. 2026-10-21 (playtest: warn the player, the phase 4 ultimate chases him): it starts with AT_Ice_King_Ultimate_Warning on himself (deep red glow for the 1.8 s charge) and the beacon AT_Ice_King_Ultimate (the encounter's phase 4 puts a red warning circle under every player), and the charge plays the Gobliterator arena horn (SFX_Gobliterator_Arena_Horn) instead of the skeleton call. 2026-10-22 sounds (SFX_AT_Ice_King_* events, rule: each sound on its exact moment): VO_Charge when the charge starts (the warning horn moved to the first step, where the warning starts), VO_Scream_Long when the beam fires, Frost_Ultimate_Pulse on each of the 7 beam pulses. 2026-10-22: the warning horn moved from the first step to the start of the charge (with VO_Charge), wanted: it exactly as he starts casting. 2026-10-22: a particle beam (AT_Ice_King_Ultimate_Beam) was tried on the fire step and dropped (preferred: the model beam); the Frost_Beam attachment, hanging from Chest, is the beam again. 2026-10-22: aim tracer during the charge (six Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Aim_Tracer shots, one every 0.3 s), see the first Projectile step.

Rage ultimate: the beam follows the player (AT_Ice_King_Beam_Focus_Rage: head turn x0.2, body matches the head).

Aim tracer (2026-10-22): the 1.8 s charge (was Simple 1.2 + Simple 0.6, same animation and hand particles at 0 and 1.2 s, VO_Charge at the start) is now six 0.3 s waits, each after a Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Aim_Tracer shot along his aim: a red line that follows his aim to the player. 2026-10-22 v2 (art pass: the tracer is now the laser itself, a 7.5-block fullbright needle reaching ahead of the projectile; the first version's particle dashes lay flat when he aimed down): one shot every 0.1 s (18 over the 1.8 s charge, 7.5 blocks at 70 b/s), so the needles touch end to end in one continuous line. Hand particles at 0 and 1.2 s, VO_Charge at the start, as before.
